name: Restaurant
description: Restaurant management: a menu with categories, modifier groups and 86-ing; floor sections and tables; a browser POS register with open checks, send-to-kitchen, order discounts and tips; card-present payments through Stripe Terminal plus cash, with full and partial refunds and printable receipts; standalone customer records; and a public online-ordering storefront (menu, cart, checkout with Stripe payment or pay at pickup) that drops orders into the POS.
author: Kohevo
